newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Bass says mulls Czech breweries merger.
newsitem.headline: Bass says mulls Czech breweries merger.

text.p: Britain's Bass Plc wants to raise its stake in Czech brewer Radegast a.s. and set up a possible merger with Prague Breweries a.s. in which it holds a majority stake, Bass country manager Mervyn Childs said on Wednesday.
"In the medium to longer term we would like to increase our stake (in Radegast) but we'll do that hopefully through discussion and agreement with other major shareholders," Childs told Reuters.
"In the medium to longer term yes we would like to consider a merger of Radegast and Prague Breweries group," he added.
Bass announced on Tuesday that it had increased its stake in Radegast, which controls around 16 percent of the Czech beer market, to 33 percent from 20 percent.
Combined with Prague Breweries, which controls around 14 percent of the domestic market, the merged comany would fulfil Bass's desire to become one of the largest Czech brewing groups.
"We've made no secret about our desire to be a substanial shareholder in a leading Czech brewing group...That group should have about 25 to 30 percent market share," said Childs.
